analysis.summary: Found 2 HIGH severity functional bugs: incorrect disclaimer reference for premium connectivity and hardcoded price label text.

bugs.title: Premium Connectivity uses Extended Warranty disclaimer reference
bugs.description: The PremiumConnectivityTab component destructures extendedWarrantyPriceDisclaimerReference from appModel.disclaimerReferences instead of using a premium-connectivity-specific disclaimer reference.
bugs.risk: Will display incorrect disclaimer text for premium connectivity products, potentially showing extended warranty legal text or pricing notes that don't apply to connectivity services.

bugs.title: Hardcoded price label for Premium Connectivity
bugs.description: The priceLabel for Premium Connectivity tab is hardcoded to 'Price for 12 Months(No Auto-Renewal)' instead of using localized text from AEM/translations.
bugs.risk: Will display untranslated English text to all users regardless of locale, and requires code deployment to change pricing terms or duration (12 months).

notBugs.reason: speculative: The diff removes the merging logic for cart compatibility info, but it's unclear if fetchCartCompatibleProducts now returns this data directly or if the feature was intentionally removed. No evidence in diff of runtime error.
Wallbox intentionally uses fetchCompatibleProducts instead of fetchCartCompatibleProducts in both old and new code, consistent with existing behavior.
Variables default to undefined if try-block fails, which Promise.allSettled handles gracefully (fulfilled with undefined). Same pattern as original code.
